name: current_controlled_training_synthesis_v1
description: Published bounded synthesis of retained matched-compute, data-supply, and seed-precision evidence.
limitations: The report JSON embeds LF-normalized SHA256 hashes for all five evaluator sources, ten training configs, and three analysis-code files.
The manifest validates published synthesis bytes; it does not rerun GPU training or inference.
The comparison has two seeds per arm and a bf16-versus-nf4 precision confound.
Seed-count calculations are sensitivity analyses based on an unstable two-seed variance estimate, not power guarantees.
